escena: SCENE (a working session, studio in Santiago, evening): she is RECEIVING, not speaking. The hard low light comes from an AZURE-BLUE calibration screen out of frame at the left and rakes across her cheek, her knuckles and the rim of her headphones, falling to near black on the far side; that light lands on HER, and the reserved wall above her stays in its own even shadow, outside the beam. She sits low in the lower half of the frame, caught AT THE INSTANT she presses the ear cup in a little harder to catch a word. A strip of ORANGE marking tape is wrapped around the base of the mic stand beside her. 85mm at f/1.8. Everything is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus corner of the desk closest to the lens
